comment: The translatable ids of the Google Drive copy's messages and the English the server sends (sbstndalton/noevia#2190 round 7). The Rust front sends them (noevia-rs offsite_mirror.rs, gdrive.rs) and Core's gdrive-broker.cjs sends driveAnswered; keep this file identical in both repos: each has a test that reads it.

messages.english: The local backup store looks empty, so nothing was copied (this protects the copy on Drive).
Waiting for the first backup before copying.
The Drive folder holds a different backup store; nothing was copied or removed.
A file on Drive differs from the local copy ({name}); nothing was replaced or pruned.
Copied, but more than {max} old files would be removed from Drive at once; nothing was removed, to be safe.
Copied, but {stale} of the {total} files on Drive are not in the local store; nothing was removed, to be safe.
